Describe the project and understand how BYgram assigns an identity.

Identity and version

BYgram derives a stable package ID from the original ID and normalizes 1.2 to 1.2.0. Keep the original ID stable across updates.

Catalog metadata

Supply a literal name, author and description. Sticker references such as exteraPlugins/1 are supported. BYgram has its own SDK and build checks for the converted manifest.
